CN2-8F4K2.title: Computer Networks Unit 2 Test
CN2-8F4K2.description: Comprehensive test on Transport Layer protocols, TCP connection management, reliable byte-stream framing, and congestion control algorithms.

questions.question: Which protocol guarantees reliable, connection-oriented and ordered byte-stream delivery at the Transport Layer?
questions.explanation: TCP provides full-duplex, connection-oriented, sequenced, and reliable byte-stream transmission using ACKs and sequence numbers.

questions.question: True or False: UDP performs a three-way handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK) before transmitting payload packets.
questions.explanation: False. UDP is connectionless and sends datagrams without initiating a three-way handshake.

questions.question: What is the standard socket option used in TCP servers to reuse local port addresses without waiting for the TIME_WAIT state to expire?
questions.explanation: SO_REUSEADDR permits a server socket to bind immediately to a local address/port still in TIME_WAIT state.

questions.question: In TCP congestion control, which algorithm halves the congestion window (cwnd) or resets ssthresh upon experiencing packet loss?
questions.explanation: Fast Recovery / AIMD handles packet loss by setting ssthresh to cwnd/2 and maintaining higher pipeline utilization.

questions.question: What framing technique is used by the NetQuiz TCP socket server to delimit structured messages across a continuous byte stream?
questions.explanation: NetQuiz uses newline-delimited JSON framing so client and server can reliably detect message boundaries over TCP byte streams.
